items.title: Strengthening El Nino 'adding fuel to a planet already on fire': UN chief
items.summary: A strengthening El Niño that could shatter all-time records is "adding fuel to a planet already on fire" and pushing the world into "uncharted territory," U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned Friday.

items.title: A new genetic tool helps researchers uncover the logic of gene regulation

items.title: Newly discovered mechanism protects DNA during cell division
items.summary: Every time a cell divides, it must accurately copy and distribute its DNA between two new cells. However, in some cases, chromosomes do not fully separate, leaving behind thin strands of DNA known as DNA bridges that connect the two newly formed cells.
